newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Swedish cameraman wounded in Zaire war zone.
newsitem.headline: Swedish cameraman wounded in Zaire war zone.

text.p: A Swedish television cameraman was wounded in the leg in the war-ravaged east Zaire city of Goma on Saturday, correspondents said.
Bengt Stenvall of TV4 was shot by unidentified uniformed men just outside the Nyera hotel in Goma.
He was evacuated by journalist colleagues and is now in hospital in the Rwanda border town of Gisenyi.
"He has lost a lot of blood," said one journalist with him. "He is in shock but he is going to be fine. It was a flesh wound from a Kalashnikov in the back of his leg."
